Commentary.Commentary: SRI LANKA HAVE DECLARED! The Sri Lankan coach they wanted to declare after Tea time yesterday but there were some clouds and they didn't want to bowl with a wet ball. So Zimbabwe need 412 runs to win. Their job is pretty easy - bat out the overs. Sri Lanka will back themselves to take 10 wickets today. The skipper Herath will be the key for them.

Hello everyone to the coverage of day 5 of the first Test between Zimbabwe and Sri Lanka in Harare. The visitors are firmly in control with a commanding lead of 411 runs and you can just expect an overnight declaration. We lost some overs towards the end yesterday due to rain and as a result, we have an early start. Zimbabwe wouldn't want to face that many overs batting fourth on the final day so they would want Sri Lanka to bat more. Promises to be an exciting fifth day of Test cricket!
...Day 5, Session 1...

No improvement in conditions and PLAY HAS BEEN CALLED OFF! There will be an early start tomorrow. This game is heavily loaded in favour of Sri Lanka and in all likelihood there will be an overnight declaration. They lead by 411 runs and will hope to get a full day's game tomorrow to give themselves a chance of taking 10 wickets. Promises to be an exciting finish. Let's hope the weather doesn't play spoilsport. Do join us at 1300 IST for all the action. Cheers!

Update 1959 IST - The rain seemed to be easing off a little while ago but it has picked up its intensity once again. The covers remain firmly in its place. The wait continues. Stay tuned, we will keep you posted.
IT HAS STARTED TO RAIN! The umpires were spot on to bring on the covers. The rain looks heavy too. Let's hope we don't have a long delay. Stay tuned as we'll keep you posted with latest updates.
The umpires are having another discussion. It's gone dark and the umpires finally decide to take the players off. COVERS ARE COMING ON! It's just as a precautionary measure as of now though.
Short ball on off, Gunaratne pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
On the pads, Perera works it down the leg side for a single.
Short of a length ball on middle, Gunaratne pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Fullish and on the pads, Perera tickles it to fine leg for three runs to get off the mark. Good running between the wickets. Three leg byes given.
No declaration yet. DILRUWAN PERERA walks out to bat. It's gone a bit dark too. In fact the umpires are having a word. They're staying for the moment. The ground staff is ready though.

OUT! STRAIGHT TO THE FIELDER! Good length ball outside off, de Silva looks to push but the ball stops a bit and goes off the outside edge towards the point fielder. Waller fielding there takes an easy catch and de Silva's fine knock comes to an end. Sri Lanka lead by 405 runs.
Fullish outside off, played towards point but there is a fielder.
Full and wide outside off, Gunaratne goes after it but misses. They need quick runs, which looks obvious.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
Play and a miss! Landed outside off, de Silva comes down the track and goes for a big shot but misses it completely.
Full outside off, driven towards cover but the fielder does well to stop the ball.
Fuller length ball outside off, Gunaratne drives it through covers for a single.
Worked away through the mid-wicket region for a single to end the over.
Appeal for an LBW! Short of a length ball, Gunaratne looks to pull but gets hit on the thigh pad. The umpire turns down the appeal as height was the factor.
Full around off, driven through mid on for a single.
Back of a length ball outside off, de Silva punches it to the off side.
Around off, Gunaratne flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.

Landed outside off, de Silva pushes it towards cover-point and looks for a run but they don't take it. There is a throw at the striker's end but the fielder misses his shy. No backup and the batsmen take a run eventually.
MUMBA to bowl from the other end.
Landed outside off, Gunaratne pushes it towards point.
Fuller length ball on off, driven to long on for a single.
Fuller length ball wide outside off, Gunaratne leaves it alone. The keeper fumbles and the batsmen steal a bye.
JUST OVER THE FIELDER! Way outside off, de Silva goes after it and slashes it just over the gully fielder for a single.
Landed outside off, de Silva pushes it to covers.
Good length ball on off, Gunaratne flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
We are back for the final session! Sri Lanka haven't declared yet. GUNARATNE and DE SILVA to continue. MPOFU to bowl. There are some clouds but not really threatening.
...Day 4, Session 3...

Once again it was Carl Mumba who impressed with the ball and apart from him the rest just were going through the motion. Now the ball is in Herath's court and he has to take the decision of when to declare. They can do that now or might look to bat for another 5-10 overs after tea. Let's wait and watch what happens next.

Fine session for Sri Lanka! They batted with authority and have swelled their lead to 395 runs. Dimuth Karunaratne departed soon after scoring an excellent century and propelled the Lankan innings with ease. He along with Dhananjaya de Silva shared a 94-run stand and shut down all the hopes of Zimbabwe to make any inroads into Sri Lankan batting.
FOUR! Poor delivery, short and wide outside off, de Silva camps back and whacks it through backward point for a cracking boundary. TEA ON DAY 4!
Driven towards the mid off region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Short and outside off, cut through point for a single.
Goes down on one knee and sweeps it fine down the leg side for a couple.
Strides forward and brings a straight bat in defense.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman.
FOUR! Slower short ball on middle, Asela swivels on the back foot and drags his attempted pull shot fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Full toss on middle, tucked on the leg side for a single.
The batsman tries to pull that one but mishits towards mid-on.
Gunaratne opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. They pick up a single.
Angles in a full ball on middle, de Silva drives it to deepish mid on for a run.
Flatter and on off, defended off the front foot.
Full and on middle, worked wide of mid on for a couple of runs.
Gunaratne has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
SECOND TEST FIFTY FOR DE SILVA! Flighted and on middle, eased down through wide mid on for a single. Good little knock by the young man.
Loopy leggie on off, de Silva tries to defend but is beaten.
Flatter and shorter outside off, Gunaratne punches it to covers for a single.
de Silva has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Good length ball outside off, steered through point for one.
Outside off on a length, left alone.
ASELA GUNARATNE is the new batsman.

OUT! Zimbabwe strike to break the 94-run partnership. End of a lovely knock by Karunaratne. Mpofu runs in from around the wicket angles in a slower full ball on off, 113 kph, Karunaratne gets forward to drive it through the line but it stops onto him a bit and he ends up checking his shot. The ball loops back to the bowler in the process and Mpofu accepts the return catch gleefully. Sri Lanka lead by 375!
Gently pushes it towards mid on and crosses for a risky single.
Played to the point region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Loopy ball on middle, clipped through mid-wicket for a run.
Flatter and full on middle, turned through mid-wicket for a single.
Leans forward to a full ball and drives it through covers for one.
Walks down the track and pushes a full ball back to the bowler.
FOUR! Horrible delivery, a rank long hop on middle, Karunaratne goes deep inside the crease and pulls it powerfully over square leg for a boundary.
Flatter and around off, staying a touch low, Dimuth goes back and defends it off the inner half of the bat.
Mini drinks break for the batsmen. Some message has come out as well, it seems. The umpires should not allow this but instead of that umpire Ian Gould is also enjoying a sip of water. Hmm...
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Fullish and outside off, driven to covers where the fielder made a spirited diving stop.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Short and wide outside off, de Silva flashes and misses.
FOUR! Good positive intent by de Silva. He shimmies down the track to a full ball and lifts it over mid off for a boundary. 200 up for Sri Lanka, lead by 364 runs!
On the pads, eased through square leg for a single.
Gets forward to a full ball and presents a straight bat in defense.
Driven towards the mid on region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Quicker one on middle, de Silva turns it just wide of short leg for a single.
de Silva has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
4th Test hundred for Dimuth Karunaratne!

CENTURY FOR KARUNARATNE! Flatter and around leg, Dimuth picks it off his pads and works it through backward square leg for a single. He is absolutely delighted and raises his bat. This century came for him after a span of 19 innings. He was having a woeful run of late with his spot under scanner. This knock will ease off the pressure a bit. The tour to Zimbabwe has come as a boon for him. Score against the minnows and keep yourself ahead of the competition. Good knock for him on the personal note.
Gets on the front foot and pushes it down to long on for a single.
Full in length and outside off, de Silva helps it to cover-point and pinches a single.
Fullish and on off, bunted to mid off for a brisk single.
FOUR! Gorgeous! A poor delivery to start with, full and wide outside off, inviting the drive, Karunaratne obliges and crunches it through covers for a glorious boundary. On 98 now!
Too full in length on off, Karunaratne gets forward and eases it through mid on.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Width on offer outside off, Dhananjaya hits it from the crease and places it through cover-point for a run.
A touch short and around off, spinning in, Karunaratne goes on the back foot and punches it  back to the bowler.
Lunges to a full ball and defends it watchfully.
Uppish but safe! Loopy ball on middle, de Silva gets forward and chips it back in the air. It's well wide of the bowler and goes safely to mid on. They take a single in the meantime.
Flighted and around leg, Dhananjaya plays it from the crease and works it off his pads to square leg. Not in the gap though.
Tossed up ball on off, forced down to long on for one.
Advances down the track to a full ball on off and hits it back. The bowler dives to his left to stop the ball. Good commitment shown by the skipper.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Chases a full ball wide outside off and gently pushes it towards the extra cover fielder.
Pushes a full ball off his front foot to covers.
Play and a miss! Masakadza serves a very wide delivery, on the shorter side, Dhananjaya goes chasing after it but fails to get any bat on it.
Angles across a full ball outside off, Dimuth plays from the crease and steers it through point for one.
Bowls it full and outside off, Karunaratne drives it well but finds mid off.
FOUR! Fine footwork, de Silva gives the charge and Cremer bowls a quicker full ball on his pads. He just picks it up and lofts it cleanly over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Flighted around leg, it's defended off the pads on the leg side.
Knocks a full ball down through mid on for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Flighted and full ball on middle, it's forced through mid off for a single.
SIX! A real gift from the bowler, full toss around middle, de Silva goes down on one knee and slogs it handsomely over mid-wicket for a maximum.
Lands it full and outside off, it's driven off the front foot to mid off.
A touch short and outside off, de Silva stays back and cuts it behind point for a single.
Identical to the last delivery, this time Karunaratne manages to pierce the gap at point and collects a single.
Full in length and angling away from the batsman, Dimuth gets forward and pushes it with an angled bat to gully. Remains on 90!
50-run stand between de Silva and Karunaratne.
On a length and outside off, Dhananjaya steers it through cover-point for a single.
de Silva has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Lunges and clips it with the spin to mid-wicket.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
de Silva has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full floated ball on off, defended back to the bowler.
Gets forward and eases it down through mid on for a single.
Spinning away from the left-hander, Karunaratne goes back, plays for the inward spin and gets beaten.
The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for the batsman.
Angles in a full ball on off, de Silva defends it off his front foot.
Lands it on a length and outside off, de Silva stands back and slaps it to point.
Pitches it full and outside off, Dhananjaya drives it off his front foot past the diving short cover fielder. The mid off guy has it covered though.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Good length ball on off, defended off the back foot by de Silva.
Drinks break!
FOUR! Short ball on middle and leg, Dimuth pulls it through the square leg region. The ball wins the race and goes past the fence.
Landed just outside off, Karunaratne pushes it to covers.
Banged in short on off, Dimuth ducks under it.
Short of a length ball on middle and off, de Silva pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Landed just outside off, de Silva taps it away with soft hands.
Good length ball on off, flicked through mid-wicket for a couple. Good running between the wickets.
Length ball on middle and leg, flicked through square leg for a couple.
Fuller length ball around off, Karunaratne tries to drive through the off side but the ball goes off the inside half of the bat towards mid on.
Good length ball on off, Dimuth pushes it to covers but finds the fielder.
Landed outside off, de Silva pushes it through covers for a single.
Fuller length ball on off, driven through mid off for a single.
Good length ball on off, Karunaratne defends it with soft hands.
HAMILTON MASAKADZA comes on to bowl.

EDGED! Landed just outside off, Dimuth plays away from the body and gets an inside edge. The ball beats the stumps and goes to fine leg. Brian Chari does well there to stop the ball to save a run for his side.
Banged in short on middle and leg, Karunaratne ducks under it.
The batsman has worked it off his pads behind square. One run added to the total.
Good length ball on off, Silva pushes it towards point.
Down the leg side, de Silva leaves it alone.
Fuller length ball around off, driven through mid on for a run.
BEATEN! Good length ball outside off, de Silva tries to push but gets beaten.
Landed around off, Karunaratne flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Back of a length ball on off, Karunaratne pushes it to the leg side.
Length delivery outside off, Karunaratne pushes it towards short cover.
Landed outside off, Dimuth leaves it alone.
In the corridor outside off, Karunaratne fails to put his bat on the ball.
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a run to end the over.
Length ball on off, de Silva flicks it through square leg for a single.
Landed around off, defended watchfully by de Silva.
Back of a length ball outside off, de Silva pushes it straight to the cover fielder.
Good length ball outside off, de Silva defends it from within his crease.
Good length ball on off, whipped through mid-wicket for a single.
DONALD TIRIPANO comes on to bowl.
FOUR! That's a lovely shot! Juicy half-volley outside off, de Silva drives it down the ground. The bowler fails to stop the ball in his followthrough as it races away to the fence for a boundary.
Good length ball outside off, angling in, pushed to covers for a quick single.
Landed around off, fullish in length, Dimuth covers the line and defends it yet again.
Fuller length ball outside off, driven towards covers where the fielder does well to stop the ball.
Full and wide outside off, Karunaratne goes after it but gets beaten. There is an appeal for a caught behind which is turned down.
Fuller length ball outside off, Karunaratne pushes it towards short extra cover.
The batsman has done well to keep that yorker at bay.
Fullish on middle and leg, flicked through square leg this time and the batsmen come back for a couple.
FOUR! Full and on the pads, easy pickings, de Silva simply guides it to fine leg where there is no protection. Dhananjaya gets a boundary.
Short ball on the pads, pulled to long leg this time for a single.
Fuller length ball around off, Karunaratne drives it towards short extra cover.
Short of a length ball on middle and leg, Karunaratne pulls it confidently to deep square leg for a couple.
The batsman has punched that ball through the off side.
Length delivery landed just outside off, de Silva defends it with soft hands.
Landed around off, Karunaratne tucks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, pushed through the cover region for a single.
Good length ball outside off, de Silva prods forward and defends it to the off side.
Fuller length ball outside off, de Silva tries to defend but gets a bottom edge.
Good length ball on off, Karunaratne stays back in his crease and defends.
On middle and leg, de Silva works it through square leg for a single again.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Good length ball on off, Silva pushes it towards point for a single.

BYE! Way down the leg side, no chance for the batsman to play this one honestly as he leaves it alone. The keeper fails to reach near the ball and the batsmen run across for a single. The umpire signals a bye.
Full ball around off, Silva flicks it towards long leg for a run.
Short of a length ball on off, de Silva pulls it through the on side for a single to end the over.
Landed outside off, Dimuth pushes it through covers for a single.
Back of a length ball outside off, punched to deep point for a single.
Full ball outside off, de Silva drives it straight to the cover fielder.
Fuller length ball outside off, driven through covers for a single.
Landed around off, Dimuth blocks it off his front foot.
Short of a length ball on off, Karunaratne pushes it through cover-point for a single to end the over. Successful one for Zimbabwe!
Length delivery outside off, de Silva pushes it through covers and takes one. There is a call for another run but the batsmen settle with a single.
Good length ball landed just outside off, Silva pushes it towards covers.
DHANANJAYA DE SILVA walks in next.

OUT! Caught behind! Carl Mumba rewarded for his consistency yet again. Back of a length ball around the off stump channel, Tharanga looks to play it lazily to the off side but only manages to get an outside edge to the keeper behind. Moor makes no mistake and there is a big appeal. The umpire raises his finger and Mumba gets his third wicket. Sri Lanka lose their fourth, lead by 281 runs though.
On middle and off, Tharanga defends it off his back foot.
FOUR BYES! On the pads, stays low, Tharanga tries to flick but misses. The keeper goes to his right to stop the ball but fails. The ball races away to the fence for four byes.
Length ball around off, angling in, Tharanga flicks it towards square on the leg side for a single to get off the mark.
Length ball outside off, Tharanga taps it to the off side.
Landed outside off, Upul blocks it out into the ground.
Appeal for an LBW! Good length ball landed just outside off, angling in, Tharanga looks to play it across but gets hit on the pads. The umpire says not out as height was the factor.
Landed around off, angling in, Karunaratne flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Way outside off, at 124 kph. Karunaratne shoulders his arms.
CHRIS MPOFU to bowl from the other end.
Full and way outside off, angling away from the batsman. Tharanga doesn't play at it.
Good length ball on off, Tharanga covers the line and defends.
We are back for the afternoon session! There's a Zimbabwe team huddle. UPUL THARANGA has joined DIMUTH KARUNARATNE. CARL MUMBA to continue.
...Day 4, Session 2...

Debutant Carl Mumba impressed in the morning session and picked up a 2-fer. The Zimbabwe spinners also did a decent job but they weren't able to stem the run flow. The hosts need to keep taking wickets otherwise they will be staring down to a big target. It will be a tricky call for Rangana Herath to decide when to declare with 5 more sessions left in this Test match. We might see some more attacking batting after lunch. Do join us in a short while.

106/3 - A good session of Test cricket! We witnessed free flowing runs in it and Zimbabwe also made their presence felt by claiming three top order wickets. As far as the match situation is concerned, Sri Lanka have their noses in front with the lead swelling up to 275 runs.

OUT! Mumba strikes at the fag end of this session! Not a wicket taking delivery, it's full and angling down the leg side, Mendis tries to flick it off his pads but closes the face of the bat early. It loops in the air off the leading edge and Cremer at mid on gobbles the catch safely. A disappointed Mendis departs and that will be LUNCH ON DAY 4!

FOUR! Poor piece of fielding by Tiripano! Fuller in length and outside off, Mendis presses forward and drives it crisply through extra cover. The mid off fielder, Donald Tiripano moves across to his left but fails to stop it with a dive. A bit lazy in his attempt have to say.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Full and angling away from the batsman, Dimuth drives it through covers and the fielder in the deep dives to save it from touching the rope. A single saved.
Sliding down the leg side, Mendis fails to flick it on the leg side and it goes off his thigh pad to the left of the keeper.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Turns it off his pads through the gap at mid-wicket for a single.
Action replay of the previous delivery, Karunaratne seems to have mastered the reverse sweep, times it to perfection and finds the gap at point for a couple of runs.
Plays a fine reverse sweep to a full ball pitching outside leg and pierces the gap at point for a couple of runs.
Flighted full ball on middle, Karunaratne defends from the crease.
SEAN WILLIAMS is introduced in the attack.
FOUR! UPPISH! Shortish outside off, Mendis slashes it through backward point. The ball goes through the gap between backward point and gully and runs to the fence.
Good length ball on off, Mendis covers the line and defends.
FOUR! Fine shot! Short of a length ball on off, Mendis transfers his weight onto his back foot and pulls it confidently through square leg for a boundary.
Full ball on off, some reverse swing there, Mendis digs it out to the off side.
Short of a length ball outside off, Mendis cuts it towards point but finds the fielder.
Angles it on the pads, Karunaratne flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Full on off, Mendis goes back in his crease and defends.
On middle, Dimuth flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Flatter on off, Karunaratne gets onto his front foot and blocks it solidly.
On the pads, Mendis works it down the leg side for a single.
Short outside off, Dimuth punches it through covers for a single.
On middle and leg, Mendis sweeps it through square leg for a single.
Landed outside off, Karunaratne guides it towards gully.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Shortish outside off, Karunaratne goes for the cut but fails to put his bat on the ball.
On the pads, flicked through backward square leg for a single.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Mendis blocks it out into the ground.
Fullish on middle and off, Mendis flicks it towards the leg side.
Too short on off, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fires a fuller one on  middle, Karunaratne advances down the track and drills it to long on for one.
Loopy and on off, Dimuth stays back and defends it on the off side.
Strides forward and forces it through mid on for a run.
Flighted on off, Mendis gets on the front foot and uses a straight bat in defense.
Lunges to a full ball and defends it with the turn to mid-wicket.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Short and wide outside off, Karunaratne gets back to cut it through the line but misses.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. No run.
Walks down the track and defends it back to the bowler.
10th Test fifty for Dimuth Karunaratne!

EDGY FOUR! Not a convincing way to reach your fifty but Karunaratne will take it with open arms. He camps back to a short ball, trying to cut it through point but it catches the under edge and screams down to third man for a boundary. Interesting, it's after 28 months that a Sri Lankan opener has scored a fifty in each innings of a Test match. Hmm... shows their misery!
Floated full ball on off, Dimuth defends it off his front foot.
Full and quick on middle, flicked firmly through mid-wicket for a single.
This one is too full around off, Mendis brings out the horizontal bat shot and sweeps it through square leg for a single.
Tickles a full ball with the spin to the leg side but finds the mid-wicket fielder.
Loopy full ball on off, Mendis draws forward and defends it back to the bowler.
Short this time, around off, Karunaratne rocks back and punches it through cover-point for a single.
Charges down the track and pushes a full ball straight back. Waller does well to make a one-handed stop to his left.
Peach of a delivery to end the over. Cremer gives it good flight and it drifts into the right-hander, Mendis prods forward in defense but the ball spins away big to beat the outside edge.
Quicker ball on middle, fuller in length, it's defended off the pads to mid-wicket.
Loopy ball on off, defended off the front foot.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Walks forward and punches it down to long on for a single.

Big mix-up but no harm done! A touch short ball on off, Dimuth cuts it off his back foot towards backward point and looks for a run. His partner responds but then Karunaratne stutters and sends him back. Luckily for them, the throw towards the keeper's end is wayward and Sri Lanka avoid a mishap.
GRAEME CREMER is back on.
Once again Waller is on the shorter side to the new batsman, Kusal goes back and turns it on one bounce to the short leg fielder. End of a successful over!
Dances down the track and squeezes it out to mid off. Scampers across for a quick single and makes it safely as the fielder misses his shy at the bowler's end.
Too full in length on middle, Karunaratne gets forward and pushes it back off the inside half of the bat.
Not a good delivery to bowl first up to a new batsman. It's short around off, spinning down, Mendis goes back and helps it through square leg for a single. Off the mark with ease!
KUSAL MENDIS is in next.

OUT! Masakadza, the old man, shows great reflexes there! A wicket against the run of play for Zimbabwe. Waller gives it the required flight and gets it to drift into the left-hander, Perera makes some space to play the drive through the off side but the ball probably turns away a touch to gather the outside edge. It flies to the left of the first slip fielder where Hamilton stretches to his left and takes a stunner by his standard. Lead is 236 runs!
Flighted full ball around off, Karunaratne advances down the track and flicks it off the inside half of the bat to mid-wicket. The bowler runs after it to stop the ball and they take a single.
Drops it on a length, Karunaratne goes back, fetches it from outside off and bunts it down in front of mid on for a sharp single.
Full and angling into the batsman, Karunaratne hits it back and the bowler does well to stop it in his followthrough.
Arrows in a full ball on off, Dimuth defends it with minimal front foot movement.
Good length delivery outside off, not offering much pace to work with, Karunaratne rocks back to slap it through point but ends up chopping it off the bottom edge towards the slip cordon.

Good delivery, lands it full and around off, stopping a bit off the surface, Karunaratne leans forward and across to flick it on the leg side but closes the face of the bat early. It catches the leading part of the bat and rolls safely to mid off.
Too full in length and just on off, Dimuth pushes it off his front foot, not the full followthrough of his bat and the ball goes straight to mid off.

Slower through the air and it approaches slowly off the pitch to the batsman, but since it's on the shorter side Karunaratne gets some extra second to go back and hit it down to wide long on. They pick up a single.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Tossed up ball on off, driven back to the bowler off the front foot.
Flighted delivery on off, Perera walks down the track, gets too close to the landing of the ball and almost yorks himself. Somehow keeps it out and it goes off his boots to covers.
Again Waller is on the shorter side, it's outside off and punched through covers for one.
50-run stand between Karunaratne and Perera.
Short in length first up, around off, Perera goes back and punches it to long off for a single.
MALCOLM WALLER is introduced into the attack. He bowls useful offies. A solo slip in place.
This one is bowled very wide outside off, Karunaratne decides not to do anything with it.
Shortish and angling across the left-hander, Perera rocks back and slaps it through cover-point. There is a sweeper in the deep on the off side and they cross for another run.
Fullish and outside off, it's pushed with ease through the gap at covers for one.
Digs in a short ball on middle and off, Perera jumps to ride the bounce and pulls it in the air over square leg. It falls in front of the fielder in the deep and they take a single.
Provides width outside off, there to be hit but Perera allows it through. Showing a lot of patience, Kusal. Usually he is a very aggressive bloke and attacks everything outside off.
Back of a length ball angling into the batsman from around the wicket, Dimuth uses the angle and works it through mid-wicket for a single.

Hello everyone to the coverage of day 4 of the first Test between Zimbabwe and Sri Lanka in Harare. The hosts fought back hard yesterday and avoided the follow-on but still they're behind in this game. Sri Lanka are sitting comfortably with a lead of 169 and have all their ten wickets intact. They would look to set a strong target for the visitors today, so let's see how Zimbabwe respond with the ball. It's been an interesting Test match and you can expect some exciting cricket today as well.
...Day 4, Session 1...

Moor and Cremer shared a 132-run stand between them and a handy contribution by Tiripano made sure the hosts avoid the follow-on mark. The captain was impressive with his maiden Test ton. Sri Lanka made sure they don't lose any wicket in that tricky little period of three overs. They have a lead of 169 runs and would look to build on it tomorrow. Let's see what do we have in store for day 4 then. Join us back to catch all the action. Until then, goodbye and take care!

That ends a riveting day of Test cricket! It looked like Zimbabwe would continue from where they left yesterday but the visitors came back hard today morning and took wickets in the first session. Zimbabwe were suddenly struggling badly but their lower middle order fought back hard.
